title: カーボンニュートラル概論
subtitle: Introduction to Carbon Neutrality
keywords: Carbon Neutrality 2.Carbon Pricing 3.Decarbonization Management 4.GHG (Greenhouse Gas) 5.Decarbonization Technology
educationalGoal: This course covers the knowledge required for the Ministry-recommended "Decarbonization Advisor" certification. As carbon neutrality is now essential across all Japanese industries, we aim to train professionals who can clearly explain these concepts and support Japan's decarbonization efforts.
advice: The world is undertaking various initiatives toward achieving carbon neutrality by 2050. The Japanese government is also backing efforts by local governments to realize carbon neutrality, including the designation of "Decarbonization Leading Areas." However, since renewable energy—the key to achieving carbon neutrality—is a decentralized infrastructure, the government cannot drive progress solely through centralized investment; it can only support initiatives driven by the will of the private sector and the public. Therefore, there is a strong emphasis on increasing the number of individuals across Japan who possess knowledge of carbon neutrality and can actively advance activities toward its realization. Furthermore, for corporations, failure to promote carbon neutrality initiatives has already become a factor that places them at a disadvantage regarding loans from financial institutions and transactions with major enterprises. Consequently, securing personnel with knowledge of carbon neutrality has become essential for every company. Based on this background, this course aims to cover the knowledge required to obtain the "Decarbonization Advisor" certification recommended by the Ministry of the Environment.
requiredKnowledge: Please conduct your own research and deepen your interest in keywords such as Green Transformation (GX), Carbon Neutrality, and Decarbonization before participating in the course.
